summary: Fresh independent canonical audit after Jinshi 021 date-repair curation: all 278 Chinese units, all 24 temporal or active-hint items, and all five people were checked against the current extraction. The repair correctly confines Zhao Zhiwei’s revision to Dading 11, preserves the later institutional use of his calendar without treating it as a life span, and removes the false AD 1190 precision from early Mingchang. The latter two source-specific holds are correctly retained, so this chapter remains research-blocked rather than approved.
